name: acme-companion
description: Automated ACME SSL certificate generation and renewal companion for nginx-proxy via Let's Encrypt.

envVars.description: Email for Let's Encrypt account notifications
Name of the paired nginx-proxy container
Use Let's Encrypt staging server for testing

composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes_from:
      - nginx-proxy
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/acme:/etc/acme.sh
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
    environment:
      DEFAULT_EMAIL: {{env.DEFAULT_EMAIL}}
      NGINX_PROXY_CONTAINER: {{env.NGINX_PROXY_CONTAINER}}
      LETSENCRYPT_STAGING: {{env.LETSENCRYPT_STAGING}}
  nginx-proxy:
    image: nginxproxy/nginx-proxy:latest
    container_name: nginx-proxy
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "80:80"
      - "443:443"
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/certs:/etc/nginx/certs
      - {{appDataPath}}/html:/usr/share/nginx/html
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/tmp/docker.sock:ro
